---

```{r}

# 1. Agglomerate at Family level (already relative abundance)
physeq_decontam_family <- tax_glom(physeq_decontam_rel_abund, taxrank = "Family")

# 2. Clean Family names
clean_family <- function(family_vec) {
  cleaned <- sub("^\\s*f__", "", family_vec)
  cleaned <- trimws(cleaned)
  cleaned[cleaned == "" | is.na(cleaned)] <- "Unknown"
  cleaned
}
tax_table(physeq_decontam_family)[, "Family"] <-
  clean_family(tax_table(physeq_decontam_family)[, "Family"])

# 3. Melt to long format
df_family_long <- psmelt(physeq_decontam_family) %>%
  mutate(Family = as.character(Family))

# ️4. Remove "Unknown" family
df_family_long_filtered <- df_family_long %>%
  filter(Family != "Unknown")

# 5. Collapse <5% per sample
df_family_collapsed <- df_family_long_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(Family = if_else(Abundance < 0.05, "<5% abund.", Family)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample, Family) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

# 6. Attach metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(physeq_decontam_family), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta$Sample <- rownames(meta)

df_family_meta <- df_family_collapsed %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Sample")


custom_family_colors <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae"   = "#fcfdbf",  # rgb(252, 253, 191)
  "Lactobacillaceae"    = "#febb81",  # rgb(254, 187, 129)
  "Staphylococcaceae"   = "#f8765c",  # rgb(248, 118, 92)
  "Dermabacteraceae"    = "#d3436e",  # rgb(211, 67, 110)
  "Nocardiopsaceae"     = "#982d80",  # rgb(152, 45, 128)
  "Bacillaceae"         = "#5f187f",  # rgb(95, 24, 127)
  "Micrococcaceae"      = "#221150",  # rgb(34, 17, 80)
  "<5% abund."          = "#000004"   # rgb(0, 0, 4)
)

ggplot(df_family_meta, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE), color = 'black') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_family_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_nested(
    rows      = vars(Growout, Treatment),
    scales    = "free_y",
    nest_line = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = 'top',
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.5, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance", fill = "Family") +
  facet_nested(
    rows      = vars(Growout, Treatment),
    scales    = "free_y",
    nest_line = TRUE
  ) +
  coord_flip()

ggsave("sample_barplot.final.png", width = 4.5, height = 15, units = "in", dpi = 900)

ggsave("sample_barplot.legend.png", width = 10, height = 15, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```
